lpc.note: Liberated Pixel Cup characters (2,755 files): bodies, hair, clothes, walk cycles. Attribution + share-alike required.

kenney.note: The COMPLETE Kenney asset pack (~5,000 files): sprites, tilesets, UI, props, fish (fishSwim/fishPink/fishGreen), tile backgrounds. Zero restrictions — safe for commercial videos.

kenney-particles.note: Kenney particle textures (smoke, dust, fire, sparkles) — perfect for ae-motion impact scenes.

kenney-textures.note: Kenney prototype textures (grass, stone, wood patterns) — hand-drawn background fills.

kenney-ui-sounds.note: Kenney UI sound effects (clicks, pops, alerts) — free SFX for transitions.

game-icons.credit: One line in the video description: 'Icons by game-icons.net (Lorc, Delapouite and contributors), CC BY 3.0'.
game-icons.note: 4,283 sketchy HAND-DRAWN icons: angler-fish, clownfish, giant-squid, shark-fin, sperm-whale, creatures, weapons, buildings, symbols. SVG — fetch with --rasterize to get a PNG.

fluent-emoji.note: Microsoft Fluent emoji (27,000 files): flat bold colors with dark outlines — a doodle-like look. 3D/*.png files are ready PNGs (fish, crab, whale, octopus, animals, objects); Flat/*.svg need --rasterize.

humaaans.credit: One line in the video description: 'People by Pablo Stanley (humaaans.com), CC BY 4.0'.
humaaans.note: 253 flat hand-drawn people — mix & match standing/sitting/arms/legs, PNG + @2x. The closest asset equivalent of stick-figure characters.

open-peeps.note: Hand-drawn people PARTS (bodies, hair, faces, beards, accessories) to mix & match into characters. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

openclipart.note: 36,000+ public-domain clipart SVGs sorted by category (animals, food, scenery, people...). Some files messy/duplicated — pick by filename. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.
